scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c blue,green "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w worker"
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: cd worker && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && cd worker && wrangler deploy
